scope.module: Treatment Pipeline, Drop-out Prevention & Curator Analytics

features: Immediate DB update in PostgreSQL 18 with ACID and RLS support

Dual trigger: targetStage ('requires_budget' -> 'Draft', 'awaiting_decision' -> 'Active', 'no_appointment' -> 'Approved', 'in_progress_abandoned' -> 'Active', 'completed' -> 'Completed') or explicit status
Automatic setting of approvedAt timestamp upon moving to Approved
Audit event logged (TREATMENT_PLAN_STAGE_TRANSITION) in auditEvents table
Reactive WebSocket broadcast (TREATMENT_PLAN_UPDATED) without requiring F5 reload
Drag-and-Drop and selector support on frontend card item and kanban board
Identifies active/approved plans with >= 14 days inactivity and no planned/in_progress appointments
1-click recall generation from card item with curator notes and due date
Batch scan banner with total at-risk count and 1-click trigger
WebSocket broadcast of recall creation events

metrics: Fixed Search Filter Aggregate bug: Totals now sum strictly matching cards instead of all unfiltered plans

traps.fix: Added prominent Empty State with primary CTA 'Создать первый план лечения' in TreatmentPipeline / PipelineBoard, and 'Добавить первую услугу в план' in TreatmentPlansList
accumulatedDoctors state maintains all staff members even when filtered by specific doctor
Safe parsing with safeIso and safeNum prevents 'Пауза NaN дн.' leaks when date strings are missing or malformed
